Test Case Description: Verify Client Supervision module loads successfully
Preconditions: User is authenticated and has access to Client Supervision (Module ID 7080)
Test Steps:
1. Log in to KAIRO
2. Navigate to Identities > Client Supervision
3. Wait for the page to load completely
Expected Result: Page loads without errors. All sections (Client Supervision list and Client Details) are visible. No JavaScript errors in console.

Test Case Description: Verify initial action button states on load
Preconditions: Client Supervision module is loaded
Test Steps:
1. Observe the action panel buttons on the right rail
2. Note the state of View / Approve / Reject / Close buttons
Expected Result: View, Approve and Reject buttons are disabled. Close button is enabled. No client is selected.

Test Case Description: Verify pending supervision table is empty on initial load
Preconditions: Client Supervision module is loaded and no branch filter applied
Test Steps:
1. Observe the supervision list table
2. Check the record count label
Expected Result: Table shows 'No pending supervisions found' placeholder row. Record count shows '0 records'.

Test Case Description: Verify dropdown data is populated from server (dropdowns in Client Details)
Preconditions: Client Supervision module is loaded
Test Steps:
1. Once a client is loaded in the detail tabs verify each dropdown
2. Check Client Type / Title / Gender / Resident / Country / Literacy Level / ID Type / Marital Status / Address Type / Employment Status / Occupation dropdowns
Expected Result: All dropdowns contain options loaded from the server via ViewData. No dropdown shows empty (except the default placeholder option).

Test Case Description: Verify module ID is correctly set to 7080
Preconditions: Client Supervision module is loaded
Test Steps:
1. Inspect the hidden field #moduleId in the DOM (browser DevTools)
2. Confirm its value
Expected Result: Hidden field #moduleId has value '7080'.

Test Case Description: Verify branch filter button opens the dropdown panel
Preconditions: Client Supervision module is loaded
Test Steps:
1. Click the Branch Filter button (btn_branchFilter)
2. Observe the dropdown panel
Expected Result: Branch filter dropdown panel opens showing a list of available branches with checkboxes. 'Select All' checkbox is visible at the top.

Test Case Description: Verify selecting a single branch in the filter
Preconditions: Branch filter panel is open and branches are listed
Test Steps:
1. Check a single branch checkbox from the list
2. Observe the filter button label
Expected Result: The selected branch name/code appears in the branch filter button label text (spn_branchFilterText). Checkbox remains checked.

Test Case Description: Verify selecting multiple branches in the filter
Preconditions: Branch filter panel is open
Test Steps:
1. Check two or more branch checkboxes
2. Observe the filter button label
Expected Result: Filter button label updates to show multiple branches selected (e.g. 'Branch A, Branch B' or count summary).

Test Case Description: Verify Select All branches checkbox
Preconditions: Branch filter panel is open with multiple branches available
Test Steps:
1. Click the 'Select All' checkbox (chk_selectAllBranches)
2. Observe all individual branch checkboxes
Expected Result: All branch checkboxes become checked. 'Select All' checkbox is checked.

Test Case Description: Verify deselecting all branches via Select All
Preconditions: All branches are selected in the filter
Test Steps:
1. Click the 'Select All' checkbox again to deselect
2. Observe all individual branch checkboxes
Expected Result: All branch checkboxes become unchecked. 'Select All' checkbox is unchecked.

Test Case Description: Verify branch filter panel closes when clicking outside
Preconditions: Branch filter panel is open
Test Steps:
1. Click anywhere outside the branch filter dropdown panel
2. Observe the panel state
Expected Result: Branch filter panel closes.

Test Case Description: Verify branch filter is applied when loading pending supervisions
Preconditions: User has selected at least one branch in the filter
Test Steps:
1. Select a branch from the filter
2. Click the View button
3. Observe the supervision list table
Expected Result: API call is made with the selected branch(es) in OurBranchID / BranchList. Table is populated with pending supervisions for those branches.

Test Case Description: Verify pending supervision list loads correctly with data
Preconditions: Branch filter has at least one branch selected, pending supervision records exist in the system
Test Steps:
1. Select a valid branch
2. Click View
3. Observe the supervision table
Expected Result: Table rows appear with columns: radio button | Client ID | and other supervision columns. Record count label updates. Rows are selectable via radio button.

Test Case Description: Verify radio button row selection in supervision table
Preconditions: Pending supervision list has at least one record loaded
Test Steps:
1. Click the radio button in the first row of the table
2. Observe action button states
Expected Result: Row is selected (radio checked). View / Approve / Reject buttons become enabled.

Test Case Description: Verify only one row can be selected at a time (radio group)
Preconditions: Pending supervision list has at least two records
Test Steps:
1. Select the first row
2. Select the second row
3. Observe both rows
Expected Result: Second row radio is checked. First row radio is unchecked. Only one row is selected at a time.

Test Case Description: Verify record count label updates after loading
Preconditions: Branch selected; pending records exist
Test Steps:
1. Select a branch
2. Click View
3. Observe the spn_recordCount label
Expected Result: Label shows exact count matching the number of rows in the table e.g. '5 records'.

Test Case Description: Verify empty state message when no pending supervisions exist
Preconditions: Valid branch selected, no pending supervision records for that branch
Test Steps:
1. Select a branch with no pending supervisions
2. Click View
Expected Result: Table shows 'No pending supervisions found' message. Record count shows '0 records'. Action buttons remain disabled.

Test Case Description: Verify action buttons disable when no row is selected
Preconditions: Supervision table is loaded with records but no row selected
Test Steps:
1. Ensure no radio is checked
2. Observe View / Approve / Reject button states
Expected Result: View / Approve / Reject buttons are disabled.

Test Case Description: Verify action buttons enable when a row is selected
Preconditions: Supervision list has at least one record
Test Steps:
1. Click any row radio button
2. Observe View / Approve / Reject button states
Expected Result: View / Approve / Reject buttons become enabled after a radio is selected.

Test Case Description: Verify table row click (non-radio area) selects the row
Preconditions: Supervision list has at least one record
Test Steps:
1. Click anywhere on a table row (not the radio button)
2. Observe radio state and action buttons
Expected Result: Row radio is checked. Action buttons become enabled.

Test Case Description: Verify Client ID search field is usable
Preconditions: Client Supervision module is loaded
Test Steps:
1. Locate the Client ID search input (txt_clientIdSearch)
2. Type a valid Client ID
3. Press Enter or click the search button
Expected Result: Search is triggered for the typed Client ID.

Test Case Description: Verify client search opens lookup/picker for matching pending clients
Preconditions: At least one pending supervision client exists
Test Steps:
1. Click the search client button (btn_searchClient)
2. Observe the result
Expected Result: A picker modal / inline results appear showing matching pending supervision clients.

Test Case Description: Verify searching by partial Client ID returns matching results
Preconditions: Pending supervision records exist
Test Steps:
1. Type part of a known Client ID in the search field
2. Trigger search
Expected Result: Results are filtered to show only clients whose IDs contain the typed string.

Test Case Description: Verify searching for a non-existent Client ID shows empty state
Preconditions: Module is loaded
Test Steps:
1. Type a Client ID that does not exist in pending supervisions
2. Trigger search
Expected Result: Empty state or 'No results found' message is shown. No crash.

Test Case Description: Verify selecting a client from search results loads their details
Preconditions: Search results are showing at least one client
Test Steps:
1. Click / select a client from the picker results
2. Observe client details panel
Expected Result: Client details section dv_clientDetailsSection becomes visible. Client ID field (txt_clientId) is populated. Relevant tabs load data.

Test Case Description: Verify searching with empty input shows appropriate handling
Preconditions: Module is loaded
Test Steps:
1. Click search button without entering a Client ID
2. Observe behaviour
Expected Result: Warning message is shown asking user to enter a Client ID, OR all pending clients are opened in picker. No unhandled error.

Test Case Description: Verify selecting a client from the supervision table also loads client details
Preconditions: Supervision list has at least one record
Test Steps:
1. Select a row radio button from the supervision table
2. Click View button
3. Observe client details section
Expected Result: Client details section is populated with data from that client (Personal / Corporate / Address / Employment tabs).

Test Case Description: Verify Personal Details tab loads and populates fields for Individual client
Preconditions: A pending individual client is selected, View was clicked
Test Steps:
1. Select an individual client from the supervision list
2. Click View
3. Navigate to Personal Details tab and inspect fields
Expected Result: Client Type, Title, First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, Date of Birth, Gender, Resident, Nationality, Literacy Level fields are populated with the client's data.

Test Case Description: Verify Corporate Details tab loads and populates fields for Corporate client
Preconditions: A pending corporate client is selected, View was clicked
Test Steps:
1. Select a corporate client from the supervision list
2. Click View
3. Navigate to Corporate Details tab
Expected Result: Corporate-specific fields (Company Name, Constitution, Line of Business, etc.) are populated accordingly.

Test Case Description: Verify Address Details tab loads and populates correctly
Preconditions: Client is selected and View clicked
Test Steps:
1. After loading client details click the Address tab
2. Inspect address fields
Expected Result: Address fields (Address Type, Region, Zone, etc.) are populated from the API response.

Test Case Description: Verify Employment Details tab loads and populates correctly
Preconditions: Client is selected and View clicked
Test Steps:
1. After loading client details click the Employment tab
2. Inspect employment fields
Expected Result: Employment fields (Employment Status, Occupation, Company Type, etc.) are populated.

Test Case Description: Verify Photo / Signature tab loads images correctly
Preconditions: Client is selected and View clicked and has photos/signatures on file
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the Images/Photo-Signature tab
2. Observe preview and table
Expected Result: Photo preview shows the client's photo. Signature preview shows the client's signature. Photo-signature table (tbl_photoSignatureBody) is populated.

Test Case Description: Verify client details section shows no-photo placeholder when no image exists
Preconditions: Client is selected and View clicked, client has no photo
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Images tab
2. Observe the photo preview area
Expected Result: A 'No Photo' placeholder text / icon is shown instead of a broken image.

Test Case Description: Verify Client ID field in details section is read-only/populated from selection
Preconditions: Client details are loaded
Test Steps:
1. Inspect txt_clientId field
2. Try to edit it
Expected Result: Field displays the loaded Client ID. Field is read-only and cannot be modified.

Test Case Description: Verify all dropdowns in details tabs are read-only (not editable) in supervision view
Preconditions: Client details are loaded
Test Steps:
1. Try to change any dropdown value in the detail tabs (Client Type / Gender / etc.)
2. Observe behaviour
Expected Result: Dropdowns are disabled or read-only — supervision is view-only and no editing is permitted.

Test Case Description: Verify Approve button confirms with a SweetAlert modal
Preconditions: A client is selected with a row radio and action buttons are enabled
Test Steps:
1. Select a pending client row
2. Click the Approve button
Expected Result: A SweetAlert confirmation dialog appears with client ID and 'Yes, Approve' / Cancel buttons. No immediate action happens without confirmation.

Test Case Description: Verify cancelling the Approve confirmation dialog takes no action
Preconditions: Approve confirmation dialog is open
Test Steps:
1. Click Cancel on the Approve confirmation dialog
2. Observe the supervision list
Expected Result: Dialog closes. The client remains in the pending list. No approval API call is made. Action buttons remain in their previous state.

Test Case Description: Verify confirming Approve submits the approval to the backend
Preconditions: Approve confirmation dialog is open with a valid pending client
Test Steps:
1. Click 'Yes, Approve' on the confirmation dialog
2. Wait for the operation to complete
Expected Result: API call is made to Identities/ClientSupervision/approve-supervision with correct ClientID, OurBranchID and ApprovedBy. Success message is displayed.

Test Case Description: Verify approved client is removed from the pending supervision list
Preconditions: Approval was just confirmed and succeeded
Test Steps:
1. Observe the supervision table after successful approval
2. Look for the just-approved client
Expected Result: The approved client no longer appears in the supervision list. Record count decrements by one.

Test Case Description: Verify success message is shown after successful approval
Preconditions: Valid client approval was just completed
Test Steps:
1. Complete an approval
2. Observe the message panel (dv_messagePanel)
Expected Result: Message panel shows 'Supervision approved successfully!' in green/success style.

Test Case Description: Verify handling when Approve API call returns an error
Preconditions: Approve confirmation confirmed, but backend returns an error response
Test Steps:
1. Simulate a backend error (e.g. network error or invalid session)
2. Confirm approve on a client
Expected Result: Error message is shown in the message panel. The supervision list is NOT refreshed / client is NOT removed. No unhandled crash.

Test Case Description: Verify Reject button opens the Reject modal
Preconditions: A client row is selected and Reject button is enabled
Test Steps:
1. Select a pending client row
2. Click the Reject button (btn_reject)
Expected Result: Reject modal (mdl_supervisionReject) opens. Reject remarks textarea (txa_supervisionRejectRemarks) is empty and focused.

Test Case Description: Verify Reject modal remarks field is required — empty submission shows validation
Preconditions: Reject modal is open
Test Steps:
1. Leave the remarks textarea empty
2. Click Confirm Reject button (btn_confirmSupervisionReject)
Expected Result: Validation feedback is shown on the remarks field (form was-validated class applied). API call is NOT made.

Test Case Description: Verify Reject modal closes without action when dismissed (X button)
Preconditions: Reject modal is open
Test Steps:
1. Click the Close / X button on the reject modal
2. Observe the supervision list
Expected Result: Modal closes. No rejection is made. The client remains in the pending list.

Test Case Description: Verify Reject confirm with valid remarks calls the reject API
Preconditions: Reject modal is open, remarks have been entered
Test Steps:
1. Type rejection remarks in the textarea
2. Click Confirm Reject button
Expected Result: API call is made to Identities/ClientSupervision/reject-supervision with ClientID, OurBranchID, Remarks. Success message is shown.

Test Case Description: Verify rejected client is removed from the pending supervision list
Preconditions: Rejection was just confirmed and succeeded
Test Steps:
1. Observe the supervision table after successful rejection
2. Look for the just-rejected client
Expected Result: Rejected client no longer appears in the supervision list. Record count decrements.

Test Case Description: Verify success message is shown after successful rejection
Preconditions: Rejection just completed successfully
Test Steps:
1. Complete a rejection
2. Observe the message panel
Expected Result: Message panel shows success text for rejection in the appropriate style.

Test Case Description: Verify remarks textarea is cleared every time the Reject modal is re-opened
Preconditions: Reject modal was previously used and closed, opened again
Test Steps:
1. Open reject modal once
2. Close it without submitting
3. Open reject modal again
4. Check the remarks field
Expected Result: Remarks textarea is empty when modal opens. Previous text is cleared.

Test Case Description: Verify handling when Reject API call returns an error
Preconditions: Reject confirmed with remarks, backend returns error
Test Steps:
1. Simulate a backend error
2. Submit rejection
Expected Result: Error message is shown in the message panel. Client remains in the pending list. No crash.

Test Case Description: Verify Close button clears the client details panel
Preconditions: Client details are loaded (client is selected and View was clicked), Close button is visible
Test Steps:
1. Click the Close button (btn_close)
2. Observe the client details section
Expected Result: Client details section clears / hides. No crash. Action buttons may reset.

Test Case Description: Verify unauthenticated access to Client Supervision redirects to Login
Preconditions: User is NOT logged in OR session has expired
Test Steps:
1. Directly navigate to /Identities/ClientSupervision/Index without a valid session
2. Observe the page
Expected Result: User is redirected to the Login page. Module content is not visible.

Test Case Description: Verify XSRF / anti-forgery token is included in POST requests
Preconditions: Module is loaded and a valid client is selected
Test Steps:
1. Open browser DevTools Network tab
2. Perform an Approve action
3. Inspect the POST request headers / body
Expected Result: Request includes the XSRF-TOKEN or RequestVerificationToken header / payload. Request is not rejected by the server.

Test Case Description: Verify message panel shows error on API call failure (network error)
Preconditions: Module is loaded, network connectivity is disrupted or API endpoint is unreachable
Test Steps:
1. Disable network or stop the backend API
2. Attempt to load pending supervisions (View button)
3. Observe message panel
Expected Result: An error message is shown in the message panel indicating failure. No unhandled JavaScript exception is thrown.

Test Case Description: Verify API 500 error from approve endpoint is surfaced to the user
Preconditions: Client selected, Approve confirmed, backend returns HTTP 500
Test Steps:
1. Confirm approval
2. Backend returns 500
3. Observe UI
Expected Result: Error message is shown to the user. Client does NOT disappear from the list. Module remains stable.

Test Case Description: Verify API 401 Unauthorized response is handled gracefully
Preconditions: Session expires after page load, Approve is attempted
Test Steps:
1. Expire the session
2. Click Approve and confirm
3. Observe behaviour
Expected Result: User is either redirected to Login or an authentication error message is shown. No sensitive data is exposed.

Test Case Description: Verify supervisor cannot approve their own client submission
Preconditions: Logged-in user is the same operator who submitted the client record (if business rule applies)
Test Steps:
1. Log in as the operator who submitted a client
2. Navigate to Client Supervision
3. Locate the self-submitted client and try to Approve
Expected Result: If the business rule prevents self-approval the backend returns an appropriate error message which is displayed. The client remains pending.

Test Case Description: Verify branch data in API calls matches the selected branch filter
Preconditions: At least one branch is selected in the filter, pending supervisions are loaded
Test Steps:
1. Select branch '001' from filter
2. Load supervisions
3. Inspect the API request payload in DevTools
Expected Result: The OurBranchID and/or BranchList value in the request body matches the selected branch(es). Results are branch-scoped.

Test Case Description: Verify operator ID is passed correctly to Approve API from session
Preconditions: Valid session with operator info, pending client is approved
Test Steps:
1. Perform an approval
2. Inspect the approve-supervision POST payload in DevTools
Expected Result: ApprovedBy field in the payload matches the logged-in operator's ID from the session.

Test Case Description: Verify operator ID is passed correctly to Reject API from session
Preconditions: Valid session with operator info, rejection is performed
Test Steps:
1. Perform a rejection
2. Inspect the reject-supervision POST payload in DevTools
Expected Result: Rejection payload includes the correct OperatorID from the session.

Test Case Description: Verify SupervisionController endpoint routes are correct
Preconditions: Backend application is running
Test Steps:
1. Check that approve call hits POST /Identities/ClientSupervision/approve-supervision
2. Check that reject call hits POST /Identities/ClientSupervision/reject-supervision
3. Check that pending list call hits the get-pending-supervisions endpoint
Expected Result: All controller routes respond with HTTP 200 for authenticated calls. No 404 errors.

Test Case Description: Verify client details load from multiple endpoints (Basic / Individual / Address / Employment / Images)
Preconditions: Client selected, View clicked
Test Steps:
1. Click View on a selected client
2. Monitor Network tab in DevTools
3. Count the API calls made
Expected Result: Separate calls are made to endpoints for Basic Details, Individual/Corporate Details, Address Details, Employment Details and Photo/Signature. All return 200.

Test Case Description: Verify system handles partial data — client with no employment details
Preconditions: Pending client with no employment information, details loaded
Test Steps:
1. Select a client known to have no employment data
2. View the Employment tab
Expected Result: Employment tab shows empty fields or placeholder text. No JavaScript error. Other tabs are unaffected.

Test Case Description: Verify system handles partial data — client with no address details
Preconditions: Pending client with no address information
Test Steps:
1. Select a client with no address data
2. View the Address tab
Expected Result: Address tab shows empty fields or placeholder text. No crash. Other tabs remain functional.

Test Case Description: Verify image viewing works — clicking a photo-signature table row shows preview
Preconditions: Client with photos/signatures loaded in tbl_photoSignatureBody
Test Steps:
1. Click a row in the photo-signature table
2. Observe the preview boxes
Expected Result: Selected photo/signature is displayed in the preview box (img_photoPreview or img_signaturePreview).

Test Case Description: Verify large number of pending clients renders without page freeze
Preconditions: 50+ pending supervision records exist in the system for the selected branch
Test Steps:
1. Select a branch with 50+ pending supervisions
2. Click View
3. Observe page responsiveness
Expected Result: Table renders within acceptable time (< 5 seconds). Page remains responsive. Scrolling works.

Test Case Description: Verify record count is accurate after approving one record
Preconditions: 5 pending clients loaded, one is approved
Test Steps:
1. Note the record count (e.g. '5 records')
2. Approve one client
3. Note the new record count
Expected Result: Record count decrements to '4 records'. The table shows 4 rows.

Test Case Description: Verify record count is accurate after rejecting one record
Preconditions: 5 pending clients loaded, one is rejected
Test Steps:
1. Note the record count
2. Reject one client with valid remarks
3. Note the new record count
Expected Result: Record count decrements by one. The rejected client is no longer in the table.

Test Case Description: Verify page does not reload on Approve or Reject — only list refreshes
Preconditions: Client Supervision page is loaded, actions are performed
Test Steps:
1. Make note of any session/state (e.g. selected branch)
2. Approve or reject a client
Expected Result: The page does NOT do a full browser reload. Only the supervision list (and client details) is refreshed via AJAX. Selected branch filter persists.

Test Case Description: Verify message panel is visible and shows correct icon for success
Preconditions: A successful Approve or View operation has been performed
Test Steps:
1. Perform any operation that results in a success message
2. Observe dv_messagePanel
Expected Result: Message panel is visible with a green/success icon and descriptive text.

Test Case Description: Verify message panel shows correct icon and style for error messages
Preconditions: An operation that results in an error has been performed
Test Steps:
1. Trigger an error condition (e.g. approve without a selection — though button is disabled; or server error)
2. Observe dv_messagePanel
Expected Result: Message panel shows an error/danger icon and red/danger colour styling.

Test Case Description: Verify module is accessible from the Identities navigation menu / dashboard
Preconditions: User is logged in and Module ID 7080 is assigned to the user
Test Steps:
1. Open the KAIRO dashboard
2. Look for Client Supervision in the Identities section or navigation
3. Click on it
Expected Result: Client Supervision module opens in the window/iframe. Page loads correctly.

Test Case Description: Verify module title is correct in the window header / browser tab
Preconditions: Client Supervision module is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Check the page title or window header after the module loads
Expected Result: Title reads 'Client Supervision' or equivalent. Matches the module name in the navigation.

Test Case Description: Verify keyboard accessibility — Tab key navigates through interactive elements
Preconditions: Client Supervision module is loaded
Test Steps:
1. Press Tab repeatedly from the top of the page
2. Observe focus movement
Expected Result: Focus moves logically through branch filter button, search input, supervision table, and action buttons. No focus trapping outside modals.

Test Case Description: Verify Approve confirmation dialog can be dismissed with Escape key
Preconditions: Approve confirmation (SweetAlert) dialog is open
Test Steps:
1. Press the Escape key
2. Observe the dialog
Expected Result: Dialog closes without performing the approval. No error.

Test Case Description: Verify reject modal can be dismissed with Escape key
Preconditions: Reject modal is open
Test Steps: 1. Press Escape key while the reject modal is open
Expected Result: Reject modal closes. No rejection is submitted.

Test Case Description: Verify concurrent approval by two supervisors — second approval shows appropriate message
Preconditions: Two users are logged in simultaneously, both select the same pending client
Test Steps:
1. User A selects a client
2. User B selects the same client
3. User A approves first
4. User B then approves
Expected Result: User B sees an error or 'already processed' message. No application crash or duplicate approval.

Test Case Description: Verify audit fields (CreatedBy / ModifiedBy / SupervisedBy) in client details are read-only
Preconditions: Client details are loaded for a pending supervision
Test Steps:
1. View the Behind The Scene audit fields in any detail tab
2. Attempt to edit them
Expected Result: Fields are read-only spans or disabled inputs. Values are populated from the data but cannot be changed.

Test Case Description: Verify dropdown options match the system code definitions in the backend
Preconditions: Client details are loaded with dropdown fields visible
Test Steps:
1. Note the options in the Gender dropdown
2. Compare with system codes for GenderID in the database
Expected Result: Options match the configured system codes; no stale / extra options appear.

Test Case Description: Verify Client ID search is case-insensitive
Preconditions: Pending client with known Client ID exists (e.g. 'CLI001')
Test Steps:
1. Type the Client ID in uppercase in search
2. Type it in lowercase
3. Compare results
Expected Result: Both searches return the same client. Search is case-insensitive.

Test Case Description: Verify multiple sequential approvals work correctly (approve 3 clients one by one)
Preconditions: 3+ pending clients exist
Test Steps:
1. Select client 1
2. Approve it
3. Select client 2
4. Approve it
5. Select client 3
6. Approve it
Expected Result: Each approval succeeds independently. List refreshes after each. Total count decrements each time. No button state freezes.

Test Case Description: Verify action buttons reset after all clients are approved (empty list)
Preconditions: Only one client remains pending
Test Steps:
1. Approve the last pending client
2. Observe action button states and table
Expected Result: Table shows empty state. View / Approve / Reject buttons are disabled (no selection possible). Record count is 0.

Test Case Description: Verify the module does not retain previous client details when a new client is selected
Preconditions: Client A details are loaded, user selects Client B
Test Steps:
1. Load Client A by clicking View
2. Select Client B from the supervision table
3. Click View
4. Inspect all detail fields
Expected Result: All fields are cleared and repopulated with Client B's data. No stale data from Client A is visible.
